text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Responding to a message saying Tsumugi has a request for him,
{0} heads to the remote outskirts of Landosol.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ツムギから頼みたいことがあると呼び出され、
{0}は人気の少ない郊外へとやって来た。

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: Mr. Knight. Thank you for joining me here today.
text_block_list.orig_text:
騎士さん。
今日は来てくれてありがとうございます。

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
I didn't want anyone else to know about this,
so I picked somewhere we wouldn't be overheard.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あまり他の人には聞かれたくない話なので、
こんな場所になっちゃいました。

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: Mr. Knight. Um... The thing is...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……騎士さん。
あの、
実は……！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
Someone's been following the members of Carmina around,
so I need to take them out! Will you help me?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
最近カルミナのメンバーにつきまとう輩がいるので、
一緒に退治してください！　
お願いします！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure you remember our debut concert—well, ever since then,
we've all had this feeling that someone's watching us.
text_block_list.orig_text:
騎士さんも見に来たカルミナの初ライブの後から、
人の気配みたいなものをよく感じるようになったんですよ。

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
They must be plotting to harm Nozomi and Chika!
The two of them are really popular, and anyone can see why!
text_block_list.orig_text:
きっとノゾミさんとチカさんが標的です！
お二人は人気もありますし、
魅力的な方々ですから！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
But as the manager of the group, it's my job to keep them safe!
If I leave this threat unattended to,
who knows what might happen to them?!
choice_data_list: You're a member of Carmina too, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ですがそんな二人を守るのが、
裏方も兼ねる私の務め！
このまま野放しにしていたら、
何が起こってもおかしくありません！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
Oh, don't worry about me.
Heck, if someone was following [i]me[/i] around, I'd be the first to notice.
What do you take me for?
text_block_list.orig_text:
私はいいんです。
っていうか私につきまとう人がいたら先に気づきますよ。
舐めないでください！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
I haven't watched over Rei all this time for nothing.
I know a thing or two about people-watching.
text_block_list.orig_text:
伊達にレイ様を見守ってきたわけじゃありません。
人の視線には敏感なほうなんです。

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I'm not all that popular in the first place!
But it's nice that you'd worry about me... Thank you for that.
text_block_list.orig_text:
私はそこまで人気がないので大丈夫です！
一応心配してくれるんですね……
ありがとうございます。

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, we can't wait until something happens.
We have to track down the culprit proactively!
text_block_list.orig_text:
とにかく、
何か起こってからでは遅いので、
私たちで協力して犯人を捕まえましょう！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Starting the next day, {0} takes charge of
Carmina's on-site security on Tsumugi's instructions.
text_block_list.orig_text:
──翌日から{0}は、
ツムギの指示でカルミナの仕事現場の警備を担当することになった。

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
I need you to keep a close eye on the area around Chika and Nozomi!
If we keep them under a tight guard, the culprit might give up and leave!
text_block_list.orig_text:
今日から騎士さんは、
チカさんとノゾミさんの周辺を監視してください！
それに二人でガードを固めれば、
近寄ってこなくなるかも知れません！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
But just in case the scoundrel shows himself,
I've set up a number of traps around here to capture him!
text_block_list.orig_text:
万が一相手が姿を見せても大丈夫なように、
捕獲用の罠もあちこちに仕掛けてあります！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
Careful you don't get caught in them yourself!
Though if you take the culprit down with you, I'll allow it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
間違って引っかかっちゃダメですよ？
犯人もろとも自爆するなら許可します！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
That should do it...
I'll make that creeper regret he ever tried to mess with Carmina!Now! Whenever you're ready, bring it on!
text_block_list.orig_text:
これでよし……
カルミナのメンバーを狙ったこと、
後悔させてやりますよ！
さあ！　
どっからでもかかってこーい！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: The next day...
text_block_list.orig_text: ──次の日。

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: Bring it on!
text_block_list.orig_text: かかってこーい！！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: The day after that...
text_block_list.orig_text: ──その次の日。

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: Bring it on!!!
text_block_list.orig_text: かかってこぉーい！！！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: A few days later...
text_block_list.orig_text: ──それから数日後。

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
Nothing's happening at all...
I haven't even felt his eyes on me for a while.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……なーんにも起きませんね……
気配も感じられなくなっちゃいました。

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
Ahh! Could it be he actually sensed danger
and fled with his tail between his legs?
choice_data_list: That would be for the best.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はっ！　
もしかして
危険を察知して、
身を引いたんじゃないでしょうか？

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: Yes, I'm sure that's it! Whew, thank goodness!
text_block_list.orig_text:
きっとそうですよ！　
あー良かった！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
You think so too, huh?
I guess our unparalleled security efforts did their job!
text_block_list.orig_text:
騎士さんもそう思います？
あれだけ厳しい警戒網を敷いた結果が出ましたね！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
I have a dance lesson soon, but now I can practice in peace!
Mr. Knight, thank you for all your hard work!
text_block_list.orig_text:
これからダンスレッスンなんですけど、
安心して行けます。
騎士さん。
数日間、
ご苦労様でした！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
Here you go—your payment for this job!
Well then, I should get going! See you around!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はいどうぞ、
今回の報酬です！
それじゃあ私行きますね！　
お疲れ様でーす！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: Whew...
text_block_list.orig_text: ふぅ……

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
Today's lesson was pretty tough, but I think
I've gotten the hang of the steps now!
text_block_list.orig_text:
今日のレッスンも厳しかったけど、
少しは上手くステップが踏めるようになったかも……！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: I feel like someone's watching me... Mr. Knight?
text_block_list.orig_text:
後ろに人の気配が……
騎士さん？

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: Yes, it [i]is[/i] him. He's such a worrywart.
text_block_list.orig_text:
やっぱりそうだ……
心配性だなぁ。

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
Wait, huh? He's not the only one?
Must be a random passerby behind me.
If I stand still, they'll walk right past. Three, two, one...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あれ？
　気配がもう一つ？
通りすがりの人かな。
立ち止まれば通り過ぎるよね。
せーの──

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: ...They're not walking past. Who's there? Who is it?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……誰も通り過ぎない。
誰？　
誰なの？

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
They're coming closer?! Wh-what now?!
Oh no, oh no, oh no...! I've gotta run!
text_block_list.orig_text:
近づいてくる！
　どうしよう……！
やだやだやだやだ……！
　逃げなきゃ！

text_block_list.text: *pant*... *pant*...
text_block_list.orig_text: はぁ……！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
I hear footsteps! They're chasing after me!
There really was someone else watching me!
Could it be... the culprit out for revenge?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
足音だ！
　追いかけて来た！
　やっぱり騎士さんじゃない誰かいたんだ！
だとしたら、
逆恨みした犯人が……！？

text_block_list.text: *pant*...! *pant*...! *pant*...! *pant*...! *pant*...! *pant*...!
text_block_list.orig_text: はっ！　はっ！　はっ！　はっ！　はっ！　はっ！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
Ah... A dead end?!
Of all the terrible luck...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ……
行き止まり！？
こんな時に……！

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text: *pant*... Ts... *pant*... Tsumugi...
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁ……
ツ……はぁ……
ツムギちゃん……

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: Somebody help! Mr. Knight!
choice_data_list: Phew, I made it in time...
text_block_list.orig_text:
助けてください！！
　騎士さんっ！！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
Mr. Knight! Thank goodness...!
C-couldn't you have shown up just a [i]little[/i] bit sooner?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
騎士さん！
　良かったぁ……！
も、もうちょっと早く助けに来てもいいんじゃないですか！？

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
You call this \"in time\"?! I-I was really scared!
But it's great you're here! I might even thank you later!
text_block_list.orig_text:
遅いですよ！
　こ、怖かったんですから！
でも助かりました！
　後でちょっとだけ褒めてあげます！

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text: Wh-who the heck are you?! Ugh! Outta my way!
text_block_list.orig_text:
な、
なんだお前はっ！
　くそっ！
　どけえっ！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: Aaahh?! Stay back! Get away from meeee!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ひっ！？
　来ないで！
　あっち行けぇーっ！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: Oh, right! This is my chance...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうか！
　今なら私の糸で……！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: Surrender yourself at once! Haaaahhh!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おとなしく捕まりなさい！
　
えぇーいっ！

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text:
Waaaaaghhh! My body's... tangled in threads...!
I can't move! Urghhh...
text_block_list.orig_text:
うわああああああっ！
　体に糸が、
絡みついてっ……！
動けない……！
　う、ぐぅ……！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: I... I did it... All right! I captured the creeper!
text_block_list.orig_text:
や、
やった……
やったぁっ！
　捕まえたーっ！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: Mr. Knight! Did you see?! I actually did it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
騎士さーんっ、
私、
やりましたよーっ！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
Wait, stooop!
Did I almost just go and give him a massive hug?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ってストーップッ！
もしかしなくても今、
危うく抱き着くところだったでしょ！？

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
Talk about a close one! This was a dangerous situation to start with,
but that's a whole different flavor of dangerous!
text_block_list.orig_text:
危ない危ない！
　さっきまでも危なかったけど、
今のは別の意味で危ないっ！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
Calm down, Tsumugi!
Picture the face of your beloved Rei and take deep breaths!
*huff*... *puff*... *huff*... *puff*... Ahhh, Rei...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
落ち着け私ーっ！
　レイ様の顔を思い浮かべて深呼吸しろーっ！
すぅっ……はぁ……
すうぅっ……
はあぁ……
レイ様ぁ～♪

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... Oh, Rei... You're such a beauty...
Whew. I'm all calmed down.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁ……
レイ様、
なんて素敵な……
……ふぅ。
落ち着いた。

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: So, um... Mr. Knight, what are you doing here?
choice_data_list: I followed you because I was worried.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あの……
騎士さんは
どうしてここに？

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
I suppose that makes sense... Thanks for that, I guess.
You really saved my hide. Now then...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだったんですね……
ありがとうございました。
おかげで無事です。
……さて。

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
Now that we're all nice and settled down...
You, on the ground! Why were you chasing after me?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょっと取り乱しちゃいましたけど、
そこのあなた！
どうして私を追いかけて来たんですか！？

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
If I'm not mistaken, you're the one who was after Nozomi or Chika...
So you've got totally the wrong girl!
text_block_list.orig_text:
大体あなたは
ノゾミさんかチカさんを狙ってたはず……
人違いにも程がありますよ！

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text:
Huh? I've been watching my beloved Tsumugi.
And you were finally on your own, so...
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっ……
だって、
大好きなツムギちゃんが、
やっと
一人になってくれたから……

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see. So it's your beloved Tsumugi you were... Wait, me?!
You don't mean... You're actually a fan of mine?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうですか、
大好きな私が一人に～……
私！？
じゃああなた……
私のファンなんですか！？

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text:
That's right! I'm your biggest fan!
At the concert, you were shining brighter on that stage
than anyone else!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ボクは
キミの大ファンなんだ！
ライブの時、
キミはカルミナの中で誰よりもかわいくて、
輝いてた！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: Whaaaa?! N-no... Th-that can't be...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
えぇっ！？
　
いや、
そ、
そんな……！

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text:
You're my goddess, Tsumugi!
Please... go out with me!
I'll do anything!
text_block_list.orig_text:
キミこそボクの女神なんだ！
　どうか
付き合ってください！
お願いしますっ！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
Ehhhh?!
I-I've never had a guy ask me out like this before...
So, um... ahhhh...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ひえぇっ！？
　
私、
告白されるなんて、
生まれて初めてで……
その……
えっと……

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
Th-that's none of your business! Don't look at me right now!
Turn 180 degrees! And another 360 for good measure!
text_block_list.orig_text:
な、
なんでもありませんよっ！
　こっち見ないでくださいっ！
あさってどころか
一年後のほうでも見ててください！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
Um, listen! There's...
There's actually someone I'm interested in right now...
So I'm afraid I can't go out with you! I'm sorry!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あの！
　私……
今は、
気になる人がいるんです……
だから、
あなたとお付き合いはできません！
　
ごめんなさいっ！

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text:
N-no way...!
I thought you were my one and only goddess...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そ、
そんな……！
ようやく見つけた女神だと思っていたのに……！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
Urghh...
This guy sort of reminds me of how I act around Rei...
text_block_list.orig_text:
うっ……
この人、
レイ様を見てる時の私に似てるかも。

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
When I'm caught up in emotions I don't know how to express,
I start acting selfish, and forget to consider her feelings...
text_block_list.orig_text:
気持ちをどう表現したらいいか分からなくなって、
相手を思いやることより、
つい自分の思いを優先しちゃう……

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
It makes me happy that you feel that way, but I think
you picked the wrong way to express those feelings.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あなたの気持ちは嬉しいけど、
伝え方を間違ったんだと思います。

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text: The wrong... way...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
伝え
方……

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
So think that over in your jail cell.
And next time you have a crush, don't creep up from behind—
approach her directly and tell her how you really feel.
text_block_list.orig_text:
だからちゃんと
牢屋で反省して、
今度好きになる人には、
後ろからじゃなくて、
正面から素直に、
自分の気持ちを伝えてあげてください。

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text:
Yeah...
I'm sorry, Tsumugi...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ……
ごめんよ、
ツムギちゃん……

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad you seem to understand.
Besides, I wouldn't have gotten the wrong idea if your skills
weren't so hopeless! You need to work on that as well!
text_block_list.orig_text:
分かってくれたならいいんです。
っていうか
あなたの技術が未熟だから、
私が勘違いしちゃったんです。
ついでにそこも反省して来てください！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
Were you even [i]trying[/i] to conceal your presence?!
If you hide like a total amateur,
of [i]course[/i] you're going to get yourself caught!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんですか
あのバレバレの気配は！
あんなに分かりやすいのは、
気づいてくれって言ってるのと同じです！

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry... Wait, huh?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ごめんなさい……
えっ？

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
And another thing! If you call yourself a fan,
you need to work on staring more subtly!
Your gaze is way too blatant!
text_block_list.orig_text:
大体ですね、
ファンならもっと視線を気取られないようにしないと
ダメなんです！
　あなた、
まるでなってません！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
A fan's job is to watch over their goddess lovingly from afar!
If your eyes are practically drilling holes in her,
what's the use in that?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
見守ることこそが、
ファンとして最も大切な心がけなんです！
僕を見てくれーって視線を飛ばしちゃ
そりゃあ相手も気づきますよ！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
You should gaze like you're cradling a precious flower!
Blend in with the crowd, and become one with the nature around her!
Watching isn't a crime, but you have to do it delicately, understand?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
視線は
気高く咲く花を愛しむように！
限りなく気配を消して、
自然や風景と一つになるんです！
見つめるだけならタダですから！
　
ただしそっとですよ、
そーっと！

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text: Um, actually... I think I'd rather...
text_block_list.orig_text:
いや、
あの……
ボクはもう……

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
You need to relearn your whole staring technique from scratch!
Hey, don't run away! Sit down! Come on, now!
Mr. Knight, you'd do well to listen too!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あなたはまず、
視線の送り方から勉強しないといけません！
あ、こら逃げない！
　座りなさい！
　さあ早く！
　
騎士さんも聞いてください！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
As he watched Tsumugi give her own stalker a lecture on technique,
{0} just felt glad that she was back to her usual self.
text_block_list.orig_text:
容赦なく男性に説教するツムギの様子に{0}は、
座りながらいつものツムギに戻って良かったと安堵した。
